item.title: Version 1.2.25 (Build 20260818)
item.description:
What's New

fix(injection): reduce AX queries into web renderer to stop Gmail/Chrome freeze

Two mechanisms caused intermittent typing freezes in heavy web editors

(Gmail compose in Chrome):

  1. FocusedElementInfo.from() eagerly queried AXDOMClassList and

AXDOMIdentifier on every snapshot. These attributes are served by the

browser's web renderer, forcing Chromium to keep web accessibility

enabled for the page — janking heavy pages like Gmail.

  1. getConfirmedInjectionMethod() did not store its live-detection

fallback result. Since clearMethodCache() runs on every mouse click,

arrow key, and app switch, every subsequent keyDown re-ran a full AX

snapshot on the event-tap thread until an async re-prime, stalling

the tap (and all typing) whenever the focused app was slow to answer.

Changes:

  • Store the Priority-2 fallback via setConfirmedInjectionMethod, same

pattern as consumePendingMethodReprobe.

  • Make domIdentifier/domClasses lazy providers (same pattern as

textValueProvider); snapshot drops to 5 eager AX calls.

  • signature uses domIdentifierIfLoaded so the hot path never fires the

lazy renderer query.

  • Gate the DOM-attribute fallback in isChromiumAddressBar and

isFirefoxStyleAddressBar by role == AXTextField: the omnibox/urlbar

are native text fields, web content never is. Eager checks

(identifier, description) now run before the DOM legs, keeping

localized-UI detection working.

Preserved: Notion code block detection, rules with AX patterns,

built-in title-only rules (never fire DOM queries), address bar

detection on localized browser UIs.

Tests: FocusedElementInfoLazyTests (17 cases) covering lazy semantics,

signature behavior, and all address-bar gate branches. Full XKeyTests

suite passes; XKeyIM target builds.

Also: bump version to 1.2.25 (build 20260818), ignore graphify-out/

and .codegraph/ local tooling dirs.
